messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for service:model-serving v2.3.0 -> traffic 5% -> 15% in 10m. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Oncall: lee. Raise :stop_sign: to hold or respond with :thumbsup: to proceed.
ashok: Hold — seeing ~30s tail latency on canary 5% in eu-west. Suggest we hold at 5% and investigate KV cache warmup before bumping.
maria: +1 to hold. Please post p50/p95/p99 over last 30m. Also recommend pin v2.2.7 for eu-west until we confirm.
lee: On it. Pulling traces now. Can we run a small traffic replay against the canary to repro the latency?
deploy-bot: Replay job queued: `replay-2934567001-01`. ETA ~4m. Will post results here.
olivia: I saw a short HTTP 502 spike on the edge for the canary during a burst. Might be nginx upstream timeout hitting because new model has longer decode loops. Propose increasing upstream timeout to 60s for the canary route while we triage.
dave: Ops prefers to keep traffic held, +1 to pin v2.2.7 in eu-west. If timeout tweak helps we can consider a limited bump.
deploy-bot: Rollout PAUSED at 5% per consensus. Action items: lee -> gather traces, olivia -> try timeout tweak, ops -> pin v2.2.7 for eu-west. I'll mark the rollout state as PAUSED.
maria: ETA ~20m for triage. If we don't see regressions after fixes & prewarm, propose incremental 10% after warmup completes.
lee: Traces look like KV cache-miss spike during warmup. Starting a short prewarm job to populate common prefixes and reduce cold start misses.
deploy-bot: Prewarm job `prewarm-2934567001-01` started. Will report when prefix hit rate >= 90%.
olivia: After bumping upstream timeout and running the prewarm + replay, initial replays look stable. p99 improved from ~1.2s -> ~0.35s. @eng-releases, agree to continue to 15%? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
ashok: :thumbsup: proceed but keep 1s p99 cutoff. Immediate rollback if any region crosses that.
maria: Good from product side. Marking hold cleared in release notes and adding note about prewarm requirement for future rollouts.
deploy-bot: Rollout RESUMED -> increasing to 15% over next 5m. Notifying oncall.
lee: I'll keep eyes on traces and telemetry. Will escalate if anything abnormal crops up.
